title: ProductEntitlementTemplate - Data API
description: Represents predefined terms of customer support (Entitlement) that users can add to products (Product2).

EntitlementTemplateId.description: ID of the entitlement template. Must be a valid ID.

Product2Id.description: ID of the Product2 associated with the entitlement template. Must be a valid ID.

special_access_rules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only Salesforce admins, users with access to the Case, Entitlement, or Work Order objects, and users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.
usage: Use to query and manage entitlement templates.
wsdl_segment:
```xml
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
<complexType name="ProductEntitlementTemplate">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="CreatedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="EntitlementTemplateId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="Product2Id" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="SystemModstamp" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
```
